anchor.semantic_hook: Looking more closely becomes a physical approach toward an examination lens that exposes exact detail.
anchor.setting: A precision-inspection gallery contains a rotating examination plinth, a rail-mounted magnifying lens, and open bays for evidence and models. The lens is so enormous that a small detail behind it expands into a solid, touchable object in front of it. That impossible enlargement is the gallery's sole surreal feature.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous lens that enlarges tiny details into solid objects

variations.scene_adjust: a used engine on a wheeled stand, loose spark plugs, and a small inspection lamp occupy the central bay

anchor.semantic_hook: Not joining in is made visible by refusing to connect one's hand crank to a shared working mechanism.

anchor.semantic_hook: Receiving relatively little of surrounding events is staged as a vast stream of happenings from which only a tiny portion reaches the receiving cup.

One enormous funnel swallows full-sized pieces of the surrounding room and releases only three bead-sized fragments into the cup. This impossible compression is the depot's sole surreal element.
